"''We don't have any, come on.|Nemec and Echo|}} '''Nemec''' was a [[clone trooper]] who joined the [[Clone Underground|clone resistance network]] founded by [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]]. He was part of a mission that conducted an [[attack on the prisoner transport ship]] alongside the defectors [[Gregor]], [[Echo]], and [[Fireball (clone trooper)|Fireball]] to rescue former [[Captain]] [[Howzer]] and two other clones. ==Biography== ===Rebelling against the Empire=== [[File:Nemec.png|thumb|left|300px|Nemec in armor]] Nemec was created on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] as a [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[human]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] to serve as a [[clone trooper]] in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone army]] during the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]]. After the conclusion of the Clone Wars and the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' Nemec would join rogue Clone Captain Rex's resistance network, the [[Clone Underground]]. At some point in [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|214}} Nemec would take part in a [[attack on the prisoner transport ship|raid]] on an [[Unidentified Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser (Balmorra)|Imperial prisoner transport ship]] that was transporting disobedient clones to an [[Tantiss Base|Imperial facility]] on the [[planet]] [[Wayland]]. After boarding [[Gozanti-class cruiser|the vessel]], Nemec battled through the ship's [[TK stormtrooper]] crew alongside Echo and eventually secured the vessel's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]]. Holding the transport's [[Imperial officer|officer]] at gunpoint, Nemec demanded to know where the imprisoned clones were being transported to, but the Imperial officer instead bit down on an [[electro capsule]], killing himself instantly. After extracting as much data as possible from the ship's [[databank]], him and the raiding party would flee the ship upon the arrival of an Imperial [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]. As the prisoner transport was strafed and destroyed by a squadron of [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|V-wing starfighters]], Nemec and the other rogue clones jumped into [[hyperspace]] on their [[Remora|ship]]. Later, Nemec accompanied [[Samson]], [[Greer]], [[Howzer]], and [[Rex]] on a [[Riyo Chuchi and Avi Singh's secret meeting|mission]] to [[Pantora]] to protect Senators [[Avi Singh]] and [[Riyo Chuchi]] while they held a meeting regarding former Republic and Separatist worlds' growing discontent with [[Darth Sidious|Emperor Palpatine]] and the Empire. Nemec was tasked with escorting Senator Singh to the meeting point, a [[Pantora tea parlor|tea parlor]], alongside Rex. ===Death=== While accompanying Rex, Howzer, and [[Clone Force 99|the Bad Batch]] on [[Teth]], Nemec was shot in the back by the [[Clone X trooper]] [[CX-2]], [[Death|killing]] him. ==Personality and traits== As a genetic clone of the bounty hunter [[Jango Fett]], Nemec had black hair, brown eyes, and tan skin. He stood at a height of 1.83 meters. ==Equipment== Nemec was equipped in standard [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] that was dyed a tint of [[Color|dark green]]. The visor of Nemec’s helmet was also green in coloration. He wore suspenders connecting to his belt over his armor and had an antenna attached on his back. ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Tipping Point}} {{1st}} *{{TBB|Infiltration (episode)}} *{{TBB|Extraction}} *{{Rebels|The Lost Commanders}} {{1stm}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Clone Troopers]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Nemec |fr=Nemec |ja=ネメック |ka=ნემეკი |nl=Nemec |pl=Nemec |tr=Nemec }} [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Clone Underground members]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
